analysis.summary: ABS Marine Services reported robust financial results for FY26, driven by fleet expansion, disciplined execution, and strong operational performance. Management highlighted increased demand in offshore and maritime sectors, supported by government initiatives like Maritime India Vision 2030 and favorable demand-supply dynamics. The company expanded its fleet by inducting the offshore support vessel Artemis and acquiring other vessels such as Hades. Looking ahead, management expects continued revenue growth and stable EBITDA margins while focusing on strategic vessel additions and operational excellence. ABS Marine Services Limited reported consolidated total income of ₹322.64 Cr and a net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10% increase in turnover from current levels for FY27, assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the EBITDA margin band of 45% to 50% will continue.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that ONGC is preparing for a 20-vessel tender.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that offshore investments are rising steadily across continents.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

demand_outlook.claim: Industry supply constraints favor charter rate growth due to an aged global fleet and limited new builds.
demand_outlook.quote: • Industry supply constraints (aged global fleet, limited new builds) favor charter rate growth

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent a total of $15 million for both new vessels, Hades and MPSV.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received delivery of the offshore vessel AM Passion.
capex_expansion.quote: Received Delivery of Offshore Vessel – AM PASSION

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis, total income for FY26 grew 75.05% year-on-year to INR322.64 crores, EBITDA increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year. EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with the PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: AM Passion was deployed under a charter with Schlumberger Asia Services Limited for a firm tenure of 3 years with a 3-year optional extension.
orders_capacity.quote: • Tenure: 3 years firm + 3 years optional extension starting from 24 June 2025

orders_capacity.claim: Top 10 clients contribute around 90% of revenue.
The company secured over 350 crores in strategic contracts.
orders_capacity.quote: Over ₹350 Cr in Strategic Contracts Secured

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the bankers are comfortable with the current debt-equity ratio.
capital_allocation.quote: With Bankers comfortable with the current debt-equity ratio ,we don't see funding will be a problem at this point of time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management stays committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
